name: CAMI binning tools benchmark
description: Benchmarks the accuracy and performance of metagenomic binning tools on standard CAMI challenge datasets.
evaluation_method: precision/recall, F1 score, and clustering metrics such as Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) to evaluate bin purity and completeness
reputation: CAMI is a community-recognized benchmark suite and challenge for metagenomic binning and assembly; widely used by the metagenomics community to compare tools under standardized conditions.
notes: Benchmark uses simulated and semi-simulated datasets that may not fully reflect all complexities of real metagenomes; results depend strongly on assembly quality and contamination and it is a non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark.

institutions: International CAMI community (academic research groups including institutes such as Max Planck/University groups involved in CAMI)
